response.sql: WITH state_accounts AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'NULL') as state_group, COUNT(a.account_id) as account_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), total_accounts AS (SELECT SUM(account_count) as total FROM state_accounts), state_shares AS (SELECT s.state_group, s.account_count, s.account_count * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_accounts) as share FROM state_accounts s), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM state_shares) SELECT ss.state_group, ss.account_count as combined_account_base, ss.share as average_share, ss.share - a.avg_share as above_average_amount FROM state_shares ss CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE ss.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY ss.state_group
